about_section.title: About FamilieHjælp
about_section.description: Familiehjælp is dedicated to making a difference for families in need. We understand the challenges that many families face, and we are here to provide support and resources that can help them navigate through difficult times. Our platform is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, so everyone can find the help they need when they need it.

functions.title: Our Functions
functions.description: Discover the range of functions we offer at ForældreHjælp, designed to support parents through difficult times. Our platform provides easy access to resources, professional guidance, and a supportive community, all aimed at helping you navigate the challenges of parenthood. Whether you're dealing with the loss of a child or adjusting to new parenthood, our functions are here to provide the support you need when you need it most.

helpingResources.headline: Our Helping Resources
helpingResources.description: At ForældreHjælp, we provide access to a range of resources that are shortcuts to quick help and support for parents in difficult situations. Our helping resources are designed to make it easy for you to find the support you need when you need it most. Whether you are looking for information, professional guidance, or a community of like-minded individuals, our platform is here to help you through your challenges as a parent. We understand the importance of having quick access to reliable resources, especially in difficult times, and our goal is to make this access as simple and effective as possible.

list_resources.title: Which helping resources do we offer
list_resources.description: We provide access to a range of helping resources that are shortcuts to quick help and support for parents in difficult situations. Some of the helping resources we offer include:

ourMission.title: Our Mission and Vision
ourMission.description: Learn about our mission and vision at ForældreHjælp, where we strive to create a safe and supportive platform for parents facing challenges such as abortion and stillbirth. Our goal is to provide easy access to reliable resources, professional guidance, and a community of support, so no parent has to feel alone in difficult times. Through innovative digital solutions, we aim to make a positive difference in the lives of families across Denmark.

vision_mission_foraeldrehjaelp.title: Our vision and mission for ForældreHjælp
vision_mission_foraeldrehjaelp.description: At ForældreHjælp, our vision is to create a world where every parent has access to the support and resources they need to navigate the challenges of parenthood, especially during difficult times such as abortion and stillbirth. Our mission is to provide a safe and supportive platform that offers easy access to reliable information, professional guidance, and a community of support. We are committed to making a positive impact on the lives of families across Denmark by offering innovative digital solutions that empower parents to find the help they need when they need it most.

behind_the_story.title: The story behind ForældreHjælp
behind_the_story.description: The idea for ForældreHjælp was born out of a personal experience with the challenges of parenthood. Our founder, who faced the difficult experience of stillbirth, realized the lack of accessible resources and support for parents going through similar situations. This inspired the creation of ForældreHjælp, a platform dedicated to providing support, resources, and a community for parents facing challenges such as abortion and stillbirth. Our goal is to ensure that no parent has to feel alone during these difficult times and to make a positive difference in the lives of families across Denmark.

our_values.title: Our core values
our_values.description: At ForældreHjælp, our core values are centered around compassion, accessibility, reliability, and community. We believe in providing compassionate support to parents facing challenges, ensuring that our platform is accessible to everyone who needs it, offering reliable resources and information, and fostering a supportive community where parents can connect and share their experiences. These values guide everything we do as we strive to make a positive impact on the lives of families across Denmark.

abortion.headline: Have you experienced an abortion?
abortion.description: Losing a child through stillbirth is a heartbreaking experience that leaves parents in deep grief and confusion. ForældreHjælp is here to support you through this difficult time by providing resources, guidance, and a community of understanding. Our platform gives access to professional counselors, support groups, and informative articles that can help you navigate your grief and find ways to remember your child. You are not alone – we are here to help you find strength and hope in a time of loss.

recomendations.title: We recommend
recomendations.description: We recommend seeking professional help and support through our platform, where you can find counselors specialized in grief counseling after stillbirth. Additionally, participating in support groups with other parents who have experienced similar losses can be a valuable way to share your feelings and find comfort. Our resources are designed to help you navigate your grief and find ways to remember your child while beginning the healing process.

parents.headline: Have you become new parents?
parents.description: Becoming new parents is a life-changing experience filled with joy, but also challenges and uncertainties. ForældreHjælp is here to support you through this exciting time by providing resources, guidance, and a community of understanding. Our platform gives access to professional counselors, informative articles, and support groups that can help you navigate the many aspects of parenthood. Whether it's about sleep habits, breastfeeding, or emotional challenges, we are here to help you find answers and support on your journey as new parents.

recomendations.title: We recommend
recomendations.description: We recommend that you as new parents seek professional guidance and support through our platform, where you can find counselors specialized in new parenthood. Additionally, participating in support groups with other new parents can be a valuable way to share your experiences and find comfort in the community. Our resources are designed to help you navigate the many aspects of parenthood and find the best solutions for you and your child.

app.app_title: Our app can be tailored to parents
app.app_description: Our app is designed to meet the unique needs of new parents. With features like personalized reminders for feeding and sleep, access to expert advice, and a community of other new parents, our app can help you navigate the challenges that come with being new parents. Get started with the app today and experience how it can make your journey as parents easier and more supportive at the same time.
app.app_feature_1: Get an overview of your children, use the tool to keep track of what you need to do as a parent for your child or children
app.app_feature_2: You have the opportunity to take notes on how often your child sleeps or note special events
app.app_feature_3: If you want to note special appointments or arrangements either in or your child should attend, you can use the tool's calendar feature
